claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft completed its 10-day mission.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft had a successful splashdown in the Pacific Ocean, off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II crew returned to Earth on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew touched down at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PT).
The Artemis II mission had safe splashdown and retrieval by U.S. Navy and NASA personnel.
The Artemis II mission was a crewed lunar flyby.
The Artemis II mission involved no landing on the Moon.
